text.card: A red giant 7,255 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.88 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,886 K at its surface.
